name: Hero villa at blue hour
usedIn: Full-bleed hero background, behind the giant wordmark
prompt: Wide cinematic photograph of a single-storey modern minimalist villa with a long flat cantilevered roof and floor-to-ceiling glass walls, sitting right at the edge of a perfectly still lake at blue hour. The interior glows warm amber: a low linen sofa, a wooden dining table, pendant lights and sheer curtains visible through the glass. The warm light reflects as long golden streaks in the dark water in the foreground. Behind the house, silhouettes of tall pine and oak trees against a deep teal night sky with a few faint stars. Camera at water level, house filling the middle horizontal band of the frame. Composition rule: keep the top 35% of the frame as clean dark-teal sky with only tree silhouettes (a giant headline goes there), and keep the bottom-left 30% as calm dark water (headline text goes there).

name: Hero foreground cutout
usedIn: Layer in front of the wordmark for the depth effect. Edit image 01, don't generate a new one
prompt: Using the attached image (hero-villa-night.jpg), remove only the sky and make it fully transparent. Keep the house, the trees, the water and every reflection exactly as they are, with no changes to framing, colour or lighting. Cut clean, natural edges around the tree branches and the roofline, with no halo. Output a PNG with a transparent background at 2560 × 1440 px, aspect ratio 16:9, same framing as the original.
tip: Easiest: Photoshop › Select › Sky, then delete. Free: Photopea (same command) or remove.bg. Or paste this prompt with the image into ChatGPT or Gemini image editing.
